name: Nagasaki

flag.description: A blue letter N drawn as a dove in flight on a white field.
flag.symbolism: N is for Nagasaki and the dove for peace; the light-blue globe shape stands for the bright sea and sky and for Nagasaki's ties with the world.

hook: Nagasaki's blue N on white is a dove, for peace; Wakayama's navy emblem on white is a fan.
trivia: Dejima, in Nagasaki harbor, was Japan's only window on Europe for two centuries of isolation.
Nagasaki has more islands than any other prefecture.
